level.setting: A cursed volcano with smoldering fissures, glowing red mist, and skeletal trees petrified by heat. The air hums with unstable energy.
level.player_weapon: Inferno Staff (base fire magic, upgraded with pickups)

enemy.name: Ember Wraith
enemy.weakness: Explosive fire (enhanced by Pyro Catalyst pickup)

encounters.hazard: The wraith's defeat triggers a volcanic tremor, revealing a path to the next area.

pickup.name: Pyro Catalyst
pickup.effect: Increases fire damage by 30% for 3 minutes.

encounters.trigger: Player ignites dry vegetation, causing a chain reaction that awakens the wraith.

enemy.name: Shadow Magmafiend
enemy.weakness: Pyro Catalyst (from prior pickup)

encounters.hazard: Defeating the Magmafiend causes the chasm to collapse, exposing the final chamber.

pickup.name: Soul Ember
pickup.effect: Deals bonus damage to bosses based on enemy health drained.

encounters.trigger: The tremor destabilizes magma pools, summoning the Magmafiend to protect the chasm's core.

boss.name: Corrupted Pyroclast
boss.victory_condition: Use Soul Ember to destabilize the boss's core while maintaining Pyro Catalyst buffs.

level.objective: Reach the heart of the volcano and purify the corrupted elemental.

level.setting: A magical forest with floating lanterns, talking trees, and candy-colored mushrooms. The environment reacts to the player's actions, with flowers blooming after victories and storms brewing during boss fights.

enemy.name: Mirthful Pixie
enemy.weakness: Player's enchanted staff (lightning)

encounters.hazard: Pixie's magic causes temporary blindness if attacked directly.

pickup.name: Glimmering Crystal
pickup.effect: Boosts the player's staff damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: Player enters the glade; the Pixie dances in circles, blocking the path with floating petals.

enemy.name: Stonebark Golem
enemy.weakness: Glimmering Crystal (from prior pickup)

encounters.hazard: The Golem summons thorny vines that slow the player's movement.

pickup.name: Whimsy Charm
pickup.effect: Enhances the Beastmaster's companion's abilities for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Pixie, the ground cracks, revealing a buried tree seed that grows into a barrier, forcing the player into the grove.

enemy.name: Lady Thistlethorn (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Whimsy Charm (from prior pickup)

encounters.hazard: Lady Thistlethorn conjures illusions of the player's companion to distract them.

pickup.name: Forestheart Amulet
pickup.effect: Restores 50% HP and grants temporary invincibility

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Golem causes a portal of swirling leaves to appear, leading to the clearing where Lady Thistlethorn awaits.

boss.name: Lady Thistlethorn
boss.weakness: Whimsy Charm (activates companion's true form, bypassing illusions)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the amulet while using the Whimsy Charm to target Lady Thistlethorn's core.

level.objective: Retrieve the Forestheart Amulet by overcoming the whimsical guardians of Glimmerthorn.
level.reward: Forestheart Amulet (grants access to the next zone and restores HP/invincibility)

level.setting: A once-sacred temple now overrun by darkness, with crumbling stained glass, flickering magical wards, and echoing whispers of the corrupted.
level.player_weapon: Lightbringer (holy sword that deals increased damage to undead and corrupted foes)

enemy.name: Corrupted Holy Knight
enemy.weakness: Holy weapon (player's starting weapon)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing pillars and cursed chains that drag the player toward the center.

pickup.name: Soul of Light
pickup.effect: Activates a purifying aura that dispels shadows for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the knight breaks the curse on the chamber's altar, revealing a glowing relic.

enemy.name: Wraith of the Unseen
enemy.weakness: Soul of Light (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Shadow tendrils that drain mana and slow movement.

pickup.name: Divine Seal
pickup.effect: Temporarily etches a holy mark on the player, dealing bonus damage to the final boss.

encounters.trigger: The purifying aura from the Soul of Light reveals hidden runes on the walls, unlocking a path to the boss chamber.

boss.name: Archbishop Malakar (Corrupted)
boss.victory_condition: Apply the Divine Seal to Malakar during the final phase to reduce his armor.

level.objective: Reach the Sanctum's core and defeat the corrupted archbishop.
level.reward: Luminous Paladins' Mantle (increases holy damage by 20% and grants resistance to shadow effects)

level.setting: A decaying, mist-shrouded forest leading to a crystalline cavern system, culminating in a sanctum where reality and illusion blur.
level.player_weapon: Illusion Staff (creates mirrors, projects illusions, channels light)

enemy.name: Shadow Stalker
enemy.weakness: Reflections from the player's illusion staff

encounters.hazard: The glade's mist distorts the player's perception, causing random illusionary attacks.

pickup.name: Fragments of a Broken Mirror
pickup.effect: Enhances mirror-based illusions, allowing light manipulation.

encounters.trigger: Player enters the glade, triggering the Stalker's ambush via distorted mirrors in the fog.

enemy.name: Golem of Endless Night
enemy.weakness: Light generated by the 'Fragments of a Broken Mirror'

encounters.hazard: The cavern's walls pulse with dark energy, draining the player's mana if they linger too long.

pickup.name: Crystal Lens
pickup.effect: Reveals hidden illusions and true forms of enemies.

encounters.trigger: The player uses the mirror fragments to shatter a light-blocking barrier, awakening the Golem.

enemy.name: The Veilweaver
enemy.weakness: The 'Crystal Lens' (must be active to see true form)

encounters.hazard: The Veilweaver summons clones that mimic the player's attacks, forcing precise targeting.

pickup.name: Elixir of Clarity
pickup.effect: Restores mana and temporarily nullifies illusionary effects.

encounters.trigger: The player activates the Crystal Lens, revealing the Veilweaver's hidden sanctum behind a curtain of illusions.

boss.name: The Veilweaver
boss.weakness: Crystal Lens (required to see true form and target the core)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core by targeting it through the Crystal Lens while avoiding illusionary clones.

level.objective: Navigate the Veil of the Forgotten, overcoming illusions and corrupted entities to confront the Veilweaver.
level.reward: The Elixir of Clarity and mastery over illusionary combat.

level.setting: A tranquil forest with glowing flora, ancient stone structures, and a serene atmosphere disrupted by corruption. The player's actions restore balance to the environment.
level.player_weapon: Sacred Mace (base damage: 40, can be enhanced with Flame Core for fire damage).

enemy.name: Stone Golem (Guardian)
enemy.weakness: Fire (via Flame Core pickup obtained after defeat)

encounters.hazard: Mossy terrain reduces movement speed by 20%.

pickup.name: Flame Core
pickup.effect: Imbues the player's weapon with fire damage, increasing attack power by 25% against fire-weak enemies.

encounters.trigger: Player enters the meadow, triggering the golem's awakening as a corrupted guardian.

enemy.name: Shadow Wisp
enemy.weakness: Fire (via Flame Core from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Periodic shadow bursts deal 15 damage over 3 seconds.

pickup.name: Shadow Relic
pickup.effect: When activated, disrupts the boss's magical defenses, making it vulnerable to elemental damage for 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The golem's defeat releases a dark aura, drawing the wisp to the cavern to feast on the corruption.

enemy.name: Corrupted Guardian (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Shadow Relic (specific pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Corrupted roots entangle the player, reducing attack speed by 30% for 4 seconds.

pickup.name: Soul of the Sanctuary
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of the player's health and grants temporary invincibility for 3 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The shadow wisp's corruption spreads to the sanctuary, corrupting the ancient guardian into a boss.

boss.name: Corrupted Guardian
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the guardian while its defenses are weakened by the Shadow Relic.

level.objective: Protect the sanctuary by purging corruption, using pickups to overcome enemy weaknesses in sequence.
level.reward: Soul of the Sanctuary (healing item) and a permanent +10% damage boost to the Sacred Mace.

level.setting: A fractured, ancient temple with unstable geometry, magical storms, and collapsing structures. The environment shifts unpredictably, forcing the player to adapt to changing layouts and hazards.
level.player_weapon: A cleaving axe with a 'Rage Cleave' special ability that requires charging (powered by the Firebrand Gem).

enemy.name: Stone Golem
enemy.weakness: Fire-based attacks (player must use the Firebrand Gem found in this encounter to exploit this weakness).

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rock pillars and sudden quakes disrupt the player's movement.

pickup.name: Firebrand Gem
pickup.effect: Temporarily ignites the player's weapon, dealing bonus fire damage and melting certain barriers.

encounters.trigger: Player smashes the golem's core with a charged cleave, causing the ceiling to collapse and reveal a hidden staircase leading to the next area.

enemy.name: Shadow Mage
enemy.weakness: Cleaving attacks (player must use their berserker weapon's special ability, 'Rage Cleave,' charged by the Firebrand Gem from prior encounter).

encounters.hazard: The mage's spells create unstable portals that teleport the player to random locations in the room.

pickup.name: Relic of Binding
pickup.effect: Grants the player a temporary aura that disrupts enemy magic, reducing incoming magical damage by 50%.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the mage, a spectral key materializes, unlocking the door to the final chamber. The mage's remains summon a temporary barrier that only the Relic of Binding (found here) can dispel.

enemy.name: Chaos Wyrm
enemy.weakness: The Relic of Binding (must be activated during the fight to bypass the Wyrm's magic immunity). The Firebrand Gem is required to ignite the Wyrm's core during its final phase.

encounters.hazard: The Wyrm's roar causes temporary hallucinations, forcing the player to navigate shifting platforms and avoid self-damage.

pickup.name: Berserker's Resolve
pickup.effect: Permanent upgrade: Increases maximum rage by 30% and reduces stamina drain by 20%.

encounters.trigger: The staircase from the second encounter leads to the Wyrm's lair, where the boss is guarded by a collapsing ceiling and shifting terrain. The Wyrm's attacks trigger random environmental hazards (firestorms, falling debris).

boss.name: Chaos Wyrm
boss.weakness: The Relic of Binding (activates during the fight to nullify magic) and Firebrand Gem (ignites the Wyrm's core in Phase 2).
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Wyrm's core by combining the Relic of Binding and Firebrand Gem during its final phase.

level.objective: Survive the chaotic trials of the Sanctum and defeat the Chaos Wyrm by exploiting weaknesses tied to pickups acquired in prior encounters.
level.reward: Berserker's Resolve (permanent upgrade) and access to the next level.

level.setting: A desolate, mist-covered graveyard transitions into a twisted forest, culminating in a decaying temple filled with ghostly echoes and oppressive darkness. The environment shifts to reflect the player's progress, with the Cursed Amulet and Soul Shard glowing faintly as they are collected.

enemy.name: Wraith of the Forgotten
enemy.weakness: Bone Scythe (player's weapon)

encounters.hazard: The Wraith's touch inflicts 'Soul Fracture' (30% damage over 3 turns).

pickup.name: Cursed Amulet
pickup.effect: Increases Bone Scythe damage by 20% and reveals hidden paths.

encounters.trigger: Player enters the graveyard; the Wraith materializes from a mist-covered tomb.

enemy.name: Corrupted Treant
enemy.weakness: Cursed Amulet (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The Treant's roots entangle the player, reducing movement speed by 50% for 2 turns.

pickup.name: Soul Shard
pickup.effect: Absorbs enemy essence to heal the player (50 HP) and temporarily nullifies fear effects.

encounters.trigger: The Cursed Amulet unlocks a hidden gate in the graveyard, leading to the glade. The Treant attacks when the player approaches its corrupted tree.

enemy.name: Eldritch Specter
enemy.weakness: Soul Shard (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The Specter summons spectral clones that attack in waves, forcing the player to manage multiple threats.

pickup.name: Ethereal Crown
pickup.effect: Grants permanent +15% damage to necromancy spells and immunity to the Specter's mind control.

encounters.trigger: The Soul Shard purifies the temple's altar, awakening the Specter. The boss fight begins as the temple collapses around the player.

boss.name: Eldritch Specter
boss.weakness: Soul Shard (required to break its spectral shield during Phase 2).
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Specter's core by channeling the Soul Shard's energy during its vulnerable state.

level.objective: Retrieve the Ethereal Crown from the temple while overcoming the cursed entities guarding it.
level.reward: Ethereal Crown, +10% EXP, and access to the next level's cursed realm.

level.setting: A desolate, cursed forest with dead trees, fog, and glowing moss. The air is thick with toxic spores and the ground is littered with bones and shattered armor.
level.player_weapon: A cursed longbow that deals piercing damage and has a 15% chance to critical strike.

enemy.name: Wraithroot Spirit
enemy.weakness: Piercing damage (player's bow)

encounters.hazard: The ground cracks, releasing toxic spores that reduce player stamina by 30% for 10 seconds.

pickup.name: Fiery Ember
pickup.effect: A volatile firebomb that explodes on impact, dealing 80 fire damage.

encounters.trigger: The forest's magic is unstable; the spirit manifests as a twisted tree spirit with glowing roots.

enemy.name: Corrupted Dire Wolf
enemy.weakness: Fire damage (using Fiery Ember from previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: The wolf's howl summons a swarm of shadow wolves that attack in waves.

pickup.name: Spirit Essence
pickup.effect: A vial of condensed magical energy. When used, it temporarily grants the player +50% critical strike chance for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The wolf emerges from the mire, its body fused with blackened bark and thorns.

enemy.name: Blighted Guardian
enemy.weakness: Spirit Essence (from prior pickup) + piercing damage

encounters.hazard: The guardian's core emits a field that slows the player's movement by 50% and increases enemy damage by 25%.

pickup.name: Eldertree Sapling
pickup.effect: Restores 100% health and grants immunity to debuffs for 20 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The ground splits open, revealing the corrupted guardian—a towering tree-like monstrosity with a glowing, fractured core.

boss.name: Blighted Guardian
boss.weakness: Spirit Essence (from Encounter 2) + piercing damage (player's bow)
boss.victory_condition: Use Spirit Essence to weaken the guardian's core, then exploit its vulnerability with piercing attacks.

level.objective: Survive the corrupted grove, defeat the Blighted Guardian, and retrieve the Eldertree Sapling to restore the land.
level.reward: Eldertree Sapling (heals player and purges debuffs), +500 XP, and access to the next level.

level.setting: A decaying space station with rusted metal corridors, flickering holographic interfaces, and remnants of failed experiments. The tension is amplified by the constant threat of the station collapsing and the AI's relentless pursuit.
level.player_weapon: Plasma Cutter (standard issue; used for general combat but not directly linked to boss weaknesses)

enemy.name: Sentinel Drone
enemy.weakness: EMP (obtained via destroying its core)

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights and unstable power surges; player must avoid electrocution from exposed wiring.

pickup.name: EMP Battery
pickup.effect: Disables electronic systems for 10 seconds (can be used on the boss)

encounters.trigger: Player must bypass a collapsed bulkhead to access the reactor. The drone patrols the chamber, guarding a malfunctioning fusion core.

enemy.name: Synthoid
enemy.weakness: Nanite Disruptor (pickup from this encounter)

encounters.hazard: Toxic gas leaks and collapsing nanite constructs; player must navigate through unstable platforms.

pickup.name: Nanite Disruptor
pickup.effect: Disables regenerative abilities of biomechanical foes (required to damage the boss)

encounters.trigger: After retrieving the EMP Battery, the player unlocks a door to the lab. The Synthoid emerges from a containment unit, its armor regenerating from nanite clusters.

enemy.name: Overlord AI (Boss)
enemy.weakness: EMP Battery (from Encounter 1) AND Nanite Disruptor (from Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: Explosive coolant tanks, laser grids, and the boss's ability to summon drones.

pickup.name: Quantum Core
pickup.effect: Optional bonus: permanently upgrades the player's tool kit (unrelated to boss fight)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Synthoid triggers a system meltdown, activating the Overlord AI. The boss manifests as a towering robotic entity with a shielded core.

boss.name: Overlord AI
boss.weakness: EMP Battery (disables shield) + Nanite Disruptor (damages core)
boss.victory_condition: Use EMP Battery to disable the shield, then use Nanite Disruptor to destroy the core while avoiding the boss's counterattacks.

level.objective: Repair the station's core to prevent a catastrophic supernova, while surviving the hostile AI and its minions.
level.reward: Upon defeating the boss, the player restores power to the station and unlocks access to the next sector, with a data vault containing rare engineering schematics.

level.setting: A derelict alien research station with shattered observation windows revealing a desolate, storm-wracked planet below. The air hums with residual temporal energy, and broken holographic displays show cryptic warnings about 'temporal contamination'.

enemy.name: Temporal Drone
enemy.weakness: Player's Temporal Disruptor (weapon) - fire a time-locked projectile at its core during a 3-second window when its shield flickers.

encounters.hazard: Flickering holograms of the facility's former researchers haunt the corridors, whispering warnings in broken voices.

pickup.name: Time Crystal
pickup.effect: Allows the player to charge their Temporal Disruptor's time-locked shot, bypassing temporal shields.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the drone, a corrupted mainframe powers down, revealing a hidden lab with a glowing **Time Crystal** pickup. The crystal unlocks a sealed door leading to the next area.

enemy.name: Chrono-Warden
enemy.weakness: Time Crystal (pickup from prior encounter) - insert the crystal into a console to disable the warden's shield, exposing its core to the Temporal Disruptor.

encounters.hazard: The chamber's floor cracks, revealing pools of liquid time that slow the player's movement if stepped on.

pickup.name: Temporal Core
pickup.effect: Destroys the boss's time-loop ability when used as a projectile. Can be deployed mid-combat.

encounters.trigger: Inserting the Time Crystal into the console triggers a countdown: "WARNING: TEMPORAL STABILITY COMPROMISED". The warden activates, attacking the player as the facility's systems destabilize.

enemy.name: Chrono-Lich
enemy.weakness: Temporal Core (pickup from prior encounter) - throw the core at the lich's time-locked heart to shatter its loops, leaving it vulnerable for 5 seconds.

encounters.hazard: The lich summons echoes of its past selves, which attack in waves. Each echo has slightly different attack patterns.

pickup.name: Chrono-Resonator
pickup.effect: Permanently upgrades the Temporal Disruptor to bypass all future temporal shields.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the warden causes a temporal rift to open, pulling the player into the lich's lair. The lich's presence warps the environment, creating duplicated corridors that shift when the player moves.

boss.name: Chrono-Lich
boss.weakness: Temporal Core (obtained from Chrono-Warden fight) - required to break its time loops and expose its heart.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the lich's heart with the Temporal Core, causing a temporal explosion that stabilizes the facility.

level.objective: Reach the heart of the facility and destroy the Chrono-Lich's time-loop engine before the facility collapses.
level.reward: Chrono-Resonator upgrade and access to a hidden archive containing blueprints for a time-manipulation device.

level.setting: A crumbling space station with unstable energy fields, collapsing corridors, and alien biomechanical hazards. The atmosphere is electric with chaotic storms and flickering lights.
level.player_weapon: Stormcaller's plasma storm cannon with EMP mode and lightning whip

enemy.name: Static Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Electromagnetic Pulse (EMP) from player's storm weapon

encounters.hazard: Unstable reactor generates random lightning strikes that damage player on contact.

pickup.name: Plasma Capacitor
pickup.effect: Increases player's storm weapon damage by 40% and allows charged EMP bursts.

encounters.trigger: Player disrupts malfunctioning reactor core, triggering Sentinel's defensive protocols.

enemy.name: Fleshforge Warden
enemy.weakness: Plasma fire amplified by the Plasma Capacitor

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling debris and toxic gas vents that reduce player movement speed.

pickup.name: Storm Conductor
pickup.effect: Allows player to channel storm energy into a focused beam, bypassing enemy shields.

encounters.trigger: Player uses Plasma Capacitor to melt Warden's biomechanical armor, exposing its core.

enemy.name: The Tempest Core
enemy.weakness: Focused storm beam from Storm Conductor

encounters.hazard: Chaotic vortexes that teleport player to random locations and increase enemy spawn rate.

pickup.name: Stormheart Crystal
pickup.effect: One-time use to overload boss's energy matrix (obtained during boss fight).

encounters.trigger: Defeating Warden destabilizes the core's containment field, unleashing the boss.

boss.name: The Tempest Core
boss.weakness: Storm Conductor's focused beam (requires Storm Conductor pickup)
boss.victory_condition: Use Storm Conductor to channel the Stormheart Crystal's energy into a final blast.

level.objective: Survive and destroy the Tempest Core while managing environmental hazards and escalating enemy threats.
level.reward: Stormcaller's Ultimate Storm Gauntlet (unlocks a storm tornado ability with area-of-effect damage).

level.theme: Derelict Space Station - The Echo of Zyn-7
level.setting: A decaying alien space station with bioluminescent fungi, abandoned labs, and corridors that shift subtly when unobserved.
level.player_weapon: Plasma Tether Cannon (primary weapon; can deploy energy traps)

enemy.name: Malfunctioning Maintenance Drone
enemy.weakness: EMP Pulse (Player's starting weapon)

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights create confusing shadows, reducing visibility by 30%.

pickup.name: Crystalline EMP Battery
pickup.effect: Stores a single EMP charge for later use.

encounters.trigger: Player activates a flickering power panel, causing the drone to attack.

enemy.name: Sentinel-9 (Reanimated Security Bot)
enemy.weakness: Crystalline EMP Battery (from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Glitching holograms project false paths, forcing player to solve a 3-part puzzle to proceed.

pickup.name: Quantum Circuit Schematic
pickup.effect: Unlocks a temporary shield generator (activates automatically when boss is engaged).

encounters.trigger: Player retrieves a data chip from the chamber, awakening the Sentinel.

boss.name: The Keeper of Zyn-7
boss.victory_condition: Player uses the schematic to overload the boss's core, causing a chain reaction.

level.objective: Reach the Core Reactor and disable the biomechanical entity guarding it.
level.reward: A prototype "Void Anchor" tool (can pacify non-hostile alien lifeforms).

level.setting: Abandoned space station 'The Necro-Array' with malfunctioning drones, ghostly holograms, and a pervasive sense of dread. Corridors are lined with flickering red lights and distant, distorted voices.

enemy.name: Sentinel Drone Alpha
enemy.weakness: Plasma blade's ion resonance (player's primary weapon)

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights and electromagnetic pulses disrupt player's aim.

pickup.name: Quantum Core
pickup.effect: Upgrades plasma blade to pierce energy shields (required for next encounter)

encounters.trigger: Player activates a corrupted terminal, triggering the drone's patrol routine.

enemy.name: Chrysalis Guardian
enemy.weakness: Quantum Core's energy resonance (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Toxic gas leaks and collapsing walls force timed navigation.

pickup.name: Stealth Cloak Upgrade
pickup.effect: Allows temporary invisibility (required for boss fight)

encounters.trigger: Player retrieves a DNA sample from a lab console, awakening the guardian.

boss.name: The Null Sentinel
boss.weakness: Stealth Cloak Upgrade (to bypass defenses) + Quantum Core (to overload core)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core while cloaked, using Quantum Core to trigger an overload.

level.objective: Reach the Core Reactor and dismantle The Null Sentinel.
level.reward: Access to the Starforge (next level) and a rare energy crystal for weapon customization.

level.setting: A derelict 23rd-century space station, its once-vibrant halls now filled with flickering holograms, toxic fumes, and the echoes of long-dead scientists. The air hums with static, and every shadow seems to move when unobserved.
level.player_weapon: Vial Launcher (can fire corrosive acid, chemical grenades, or alchemical bombs)

enemy.name: Malfunctioning Drone
enemy.weakness: Corrosive Acid (player's starting weapon)

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights and distant mechanical groans. A corrupted terminal whispers warnings in broken code.

pickup.name: Stabilized Nitro Compound
pickup.effect: Can be used as a volatile charge for the vial launcher, increasing blast radius and damage.

encounters.trigger: Player must use corrosive acid to destroy the drone's shield, revealing a hidden console. Activating it triggers the next encounter.

enemy.name: Mutated Biomechanical Warden
enemy.weakness: Stabilized Nitro Compound (pickup from previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: Toxic gas leaks and unstable floor panels. The Warden's movements cause tremors, risking structural collapse.

pickup.name: Neurotoxin Catalyst
pickup.effect: A volatile chemical that disrupts neural pathways. Can be synthesized into a lethal alchemical bomb.

encounters.trigger: Player must use the Stabilized Nitro Compound on the reactor core to overload it. The resulting explosion awakens the Warden.

enemy.name: The Hollow Core (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Neurotoxin Catalyst (pickup from previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: The boss emits a disorienting hum that distorts vision and causes hallucinations. Glowing fissures in the floor release eerie, ghostly apparitions.

pickup.name: Alchemical Resonator
pickup.effect: Restores alchemical energy reserves and unlocks new crafting recipes.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Warden, the player discovers a corrupted AI core pulsating with dark energy. The boss activates when the Neurotoxin Catalyst is synthesized into a bomb.

boss.name: The Hollow Core
boss.weakness: Neurotoxin Catalyst (must be synthesized from the pickup obtained in the second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the AI core with the Neurotoxin Catalyst bomb.

level.objective: Navigate the derelict space station, overcoming enemies and environmental hazards to reach the core and destroy the corrupted AI.
level.reward: Alchemical Resonator, granting permanent upgrades to the player's crafting abilities.

level.setting: A vibrant, derelict space station orbiting a multi-hued gas giant. The environment features floating platforms, quirky alien tech, and playful hazards like bouncing energy orbs and mischievous holograms.

enemy.name: Zig-Zag Zapper
enemy.weakness: Player's starting weapon (plasma pistol)

encounters.hazard: Floating debris and flickering holographic projections of dancing aliens.

pickup.name: Gravity Lasso
pickup.effect: Pulls enemies or objects toward the player.

encounters.trigger: Defeat Zig-Zag Zapper to unlock the airlock leading to the next area.

enemy.name: Shielded Siren
enemy.weakness: Gravity Lasso (pickup from first encounter)

encounters.hazard: Bouncing, jellyfish-like energy orbs that leave temporary force fields.

pickup.name: Quantum Core
pickup.effect: Disrupts energy fields and overloads systems.

encounters.trigger: Use Gravity Lasso to disable the Shielded Siren's force field, then defeat it to activate the bridge to the boss arena.

enemy.name: The Cosmic Clown
enemy.weakness: Quantum Core (pickup from second encounter)

encounters.hazard: Floating platforms that rearrange randomly, accompanied by chaotic laser curtains.

pickup.name: Celestial Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the station's escape pod (not required for victory but adds whimsy).

encounters.trigger: Insert Quantum Core into the boss's control panel to initiate the final showdown.

boss.name: The Cosmic Clown
boss.victory_condition: Overload the boss's core with the Quantum Core, causing a colorful explosion.

level.objective: Navigate the derelict space station, defeat three whimsical enemies, and dismantle the final boss using pickups obtained along the way.
level.reward: Celestial Key (optional) and a whimsical escape pod ride through the gas giant's atmosphere.

level.setting: A derelict research station on the moon Eos-3, featuring serene glass domes, crystalline formations, and bioluminescent flora. The environment is calm but decaying, with distant echoes of machinery and faint starlight filtering through the glass.

enemy.name: Sentinel-7
enemy.weakness: Gravitic Hammer (player's weapon)

encounters.hazard: Sentinel-7 collapses the atrium's floor, forcing the player to navigate unstable terrain.

pickup.name: Quantum Core
pickup.effect: Disrupts energy fields; can be used to destabilize crystalline structures.

encounters.trigger: Player activates a dormant console near the atrium's central pillar, awakening Sentinel-7.

enemy.name: Eidolon
enemy.weakness: Quantum Core (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Eidolon summons falling crystal shards that damage the player if not countered with terrain manipulation.

pickup.name: Gravity Anchor
pickup.effect: Creates localized gravitational fields to pull in or crush objects.

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Quantum Core to shatter a crystalline barrier, releasing Eidolon from its prison.

enemy.name: Eos-Construct
enemy.weakness: Gravity Anchor (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Eos-Construct emits a gravitational wave that pulls the player toward its core, requiring precise timing to avoid.

pickup.name: Celestial Shard
pickup.effect: Temporary invincibility; obtained after defeating the boss.

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Gravity Anchor to collapse the reactor chamber's ceiling, triggering Eos-Construct's awakening.

boss.name: Eos-Construct
boss.weakness: Gravity Anchor + Quantum Core (combined use required for final blow)
boss.victory_condition: Use Gravity Anchor to collapse Eos-Construct's core, then use Quantum Core to destabilize its final form.

level.objective: Reach the Core Reactor Chamber and dismantle Eos-Construct using pickups acquired in prior encounters.
level.reward: Celestial Shard (temporary invincibility) and access to the station's archives.
